clips.title: The story
paras: Wanted: Maggot Eye is an official death bounty posted on the Brill notice board by the town's Forsaken leadership. A notorious gnoll has been looting nearby graveyards and farms to supply dead bodies directly to the Lich King's Scourge. Executor Zygand requires proof of the creature's execution to secure the lands around Garren's Haunt.

In Tirisfal Glades, the dead are far from resting peacefully. The gnoll known as Maggot Eye earned a severe death sentence not merely for scavenging, but for active collaboration with the Lich King. While gnolls are generally viewed as savage brutes driven by simple hunger, Maggot Eye has been systematically digging up corpses and collecting remains to fuel the ranks of the Scourge army.

For the Forsaken, whose entire existence hinges on breaking free from the Lich King's dominion, feeding dead kin back into the Scourge war machine is among the highest offenses possible. Executor Zygand, overseeing local military enforcement in Brill, commissioned this bounty to put an end to the grave robberies near Garren's Haunt. To collect the prize, the executioner must sever Maggot Eye's paw as unmistakable proof that the beast will trouble Tirisfal no longer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.
The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged. Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people. On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, friend.
